title: Mid-1950s aerospace propulsion breakthrough at Martin Aircraft

tellings.quote: We know that the breakthrough in aerospace propulsion at Martin Aircraft and potentially others was also in the mid-50s where they were saying they can roll these things off an assembly line in 3 years.

plain: A philosopher, Jason Jorjani, says on a 2025 episode of Jesse Michels's podcast that in the mid-1950s there was a breakthrough in aircraft propulsion at Martin Aircraft, an American plane maker, and possibly at other companies too. According to him, people at the time said they could roll these new craft off an assembly line within three years, which, if true, would mean exotic flight technology was within reach decades ago.
